statistics: Upper-middle empirical medians: sorted floor(n/2). Percentage headlines use median of paired percentage changes, not the percentage difference between independent medians. Per-pair raw values and comparisons retained. CPU 100% equals one core. GPU engine counters are separate and must not be summed.

Noninferiority also permits greater delivery/handoff/publication work. These checks do not establish physical display FPS, A/V synchronization, device-loss behavior, or equal latency.

receipt.limits: Isolated replay of the same JSON values with a constant parsed input. Demonstrates diagnostic-history ownership on the process default heap. Not app CPU/RAM performance, not driver/media ownership, and not an exact measurement of the original GUI collector's allocation overhead. No heap optimization or working-set trim.

nativeComparisons.limits: Same 300 encoded fixture frames per context, paced at 60 fps. Includes Configure and Release CPU. Age is decoder-input-to-consumer materialization age, not network or physical display latency. Peak process commit/residency sampled at 50 ms. Three alternating pairs for four visible contexts; other cases are single pairs. Timed samples retain six frames per context for after-timing pixel checks. Compare age and delivered work alongside CPU.

sdk-v6.limits: Local observer only; original registry source unchanged. Counts tagged video texImage/texSubImage calls and their input payload, not physical PCIe traffic or display output.

sdk-v8.limits: Local observer only; original registry source unchanged. Counts tagged video texImage/texSubImage calls and their input payload, not physical PCIe traffic or display output.

Cached experiment refreshes unchanged closed history while current records change and freshness fields remain live; not all report requests or VPS/WAN capacity.
